name: Frozen Greater Thermal Shock
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 120: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 9.5 ❤ thermal
